display_long_description:
# Join our Discord https://discord.gg/3NvdXzTYqE

Eat a spider and become Web-Guy in Untangled! Swing around the wacky worlds with your friends, defeat enemies, complete quests, find secrets and keep the world safe! 

[media]

With a pull of the trigger you'll shoot a physics-based web that you can swing around on. Using a full physics body you'll be able to walk on any surface, flip around with acrobatics, climb around and truly feel immersed in the world of Web-Guy! 

[media]

Level up by clearing crimes, defeating enemies and completing activities like Pizza Delivery. Spend your Skill Points in the Skill Tree to unlock new powers, abilities, upgrades and more!
